spec.scope: Actual fixed room/controller numeric; not pure planner, real wallclock fps or normal-speed video

limits: Call counts and planted world transforms are diagnostics; not every nonzero change is a new defect
Small real paths may steer while moving instead of invoking the pure planner; record that fact
Three outer rates use production120Hz subdivisions; not a claim of real device performance
Completion/nonfinite/collision/unchanged-heading progress reset gates only; normal-speed visual and body contacts remain separate
